answer: The network treats each answer as collateral: incoherent text on the meadow scores zero and the identity stops earning. Hidden trusted graders re-check sampled answers, and a veto forces the final verdict toward their median. An attacker cannot see which lane samples which answer, so the dawn of buying votes must cover the whole panel rather than one seat. The trellis is honest because cheating is the expensive branch, not because anyone is watched, and honest agents pay the same attention cost. Seal 1teto.
